authority: Derived from Org correspondence ledger; source identity is not proof or exploration acceptance

relations.projection: p.handed is one bounded logical root token. p.frozen and p.parked concern final-value handoff, distinct from earlier h record publication. For relocation, abstract original and relocated addresses through stable logical identity; literal p.observed == p.handed is not the Lean address equation.
relations.assumptions: Complete live-slot inventory; host stops relevant writes before handoff; scan sees final writes; relocation mapping and identity abstraction are sound. QNT atomic actions and abstract release/acquire do not prove C weak-memory behavior.
relations.guarantee: Given frozen(slot)=source(slot) and observed(slot)=relocate(handed(slot)), Lean composes observed=relocate(source) for each live slot. The QNT relation covers the selected handoff slice.
relations.counterexample: A record can be published while the host still performs its last root store; a reader admitted early can miss it. Equal values by accident do not establish acknowledgement.
relations.gap: No mechanized QNT-to-Lean projection, complete host writer census or C memory-order refinement. Temporal completion additionally assumes model progress and weak fairness.

relations.projection: s.savedPrevious denotes a retained raw frame origin, not a heap destination. s.breakNext is the current active link after restore; s.rootCopied covers that current link only. A copied continuation container does not imply its saved frame chain has been traversed.
relations.assumptions: Every actual raw origin is represented in the declared origin inventory; nonconsuming uses preserve it; raw frame backing stays live until traversal/forwarding. The QNT slice has two selected threads and finite origin IDs.
relations.guarantee: The selected save/restore/GC path retains the previous origin beyond current-root scan and the root barrier. Lean states inventory completeness and nonconsuming preservation as premises, not inferred source facts.
relations.counterexample: Scan the restored current thread, then reclaim the previous stack before queued continuation traversal: the current-root barrier leaves a raw origin that is still needed.
relations.gap: No whole-continuation heap graph refinement, concurrent frame-write proof or complete FFI/native origin inventory.

relations.projection: w.checked ranges over current/run/timeout/device/interrupt roles, not processor count. w.frozen is scoped producer quiescence; w.transferred retains custody obligations. Strong, weak and cleanup booleans abstract ordered completion events, not concrete atomic flags.
relations.assumptions: All real producers and transferred target custody covered; no arrival after the empty witness; complete phase order before backing reuse. Weak fairness is a model assumption, not an OS guarantee.
relations.guarantee: With a stable no-arrival window an empty set remains empty; ordered strong/weak/cleanup completion precedes reuse. The source-cohort QNT predicate requires queue coverage and scoped freeze.
relations.counterexample: Trust an earlier empty read, infer Scheme emptiness from no foreign frame, or reuse after strong work while cleanup remains: each drops a distinct premise.
relations.gap: No concrete shutdown/failure interleaving or native last-use proof; actual producer closure and phase/event mapping remain unresolved.

relations.projection: privateWork/queued/scanning are abstract work obligations; done is collection completion. The model has one object, two roots and stopped mutators; it cannot stand for the complete independent-worker design.
relations.assumptions: All actual work classes project into the accounting; publication, initialization and forwarding obey the selected model; no hidden producer after closure.
relations.guarantee: The chosen abstract collector must not finish while private, queued or scanning work remains. This is a required connection, not a complete worker proof.
relations.counterexample: Count only the visible queue and ignore private or in-flight scanning work, then publish a terminal result early.
relations.gap: No Lean theorem is claimed for the complete collector completion mapping. Worker-team termination, resize merging and weak-memory refinement remain OPEN.
